# Sample Brief

This is a tiny fixture used by the Run UI smoke test.

The smoke test uploads this file to a session and asserts that the
file-parser produces an entry under the session's `inputs/parsed/`
directory.

Key facts to retain after parsing:
- Project name: AcmeWidget v0
- Owner: Eng team
- Vault code: SMOKE-VAULT-AZUREFALCON-4738
- Intended outcome: validate the round-trip from upload to parse

The smoke journey asks the Receptionist for the vault code above. That
value exists only in this file, so a grounded answer is impossible unless
the parsed file context actually reached the chat provider.
